        DeleteObjectsResponse.Builder deleted(Consumer<DeletedObject.Builder>... deleted)

        Container element for a successful delete. It identifies the object that was successfully deleted.

        This is a convenience method that creates an instance of the DeletedObject.Builder avoiding the need to create one manually via DeletedObject.builder().

        When the Consumer completes, SdkBuilder.build() is called immediately and its result is passed to #deleted(List).
